ms.promise: Flint iOS App NFT section where it displays compatible Cardano NFTs
ms.criteria: iOS App adds NFT section where it displays compatible Cardano NFTs
ms.report:
We have now successfully reintroduced the NFT Gallery feature to Flint wallet for iOS devices! Updating to at least version 1.23.0 will give users this functionality and allow to view and browse all their Cardano-compatible NFTs in Flint Wallet by simply tapping the image icon at the bottom of Flint.
NFTs with the same policy ID are also now grouped together for better organization and a clean look.
Clicking on an NFT opens that NFT on its own page, enlarging the image and includes a link to the Cardano explorer. Now Flint provides the support for gifs and video NFTs. 

We have also upgraded our code regarding IPFS to provide a more stable and faster NFT viewing experience inside Flint Wallet.
Flint Wallet on iOS now includes the same NFT viewing capabilities as our Android version.
Link to Blogpost: https://medium.com/dcspark/flints-recent-updates-ada-handle-support-nfts-on-ios-and-more-f0a68e3aaf96

ms.promise: New education section on Flint where blockchain concepts are explained
ms.criteria: Education section on Flint is added for mobile and web
ms.report:
Report: Flint Wallet Release 1.27.0

The latest release of Flint Wallet, version 1.27.0, includes a brand new section called Flint Education. This section is designed to help our users learn more about Flint, Milkomeda (Cardano Sidechain), and the general concepts of blockchain technology.

The Flint Education section includes a variety of resources, such as video tutorials, an FAQ section, and tips for safe usage of blockchain. These resources are intended to help users understand the basics of blockchain and how Flint and Milkomeda fit into the larger ecosystem.

In addition to the Flint Education section, version 1.27.0 also includes several bug fixes and performance improvements.

The Flint Education feature was developed as part of a grant received by the company, which enabled us to invest in creating educational materials and resources for our users. Our goal is to empower users to understand and make the most of the Flint Wallet and Milkomeda.

We believe that the Flint Education section will be a valuable resource for our users, and we are excited to continue to develop and improve it in future releases.

Please let us know if you have any feedback or suggestions for the Flint Education section or any other aspect of the Flint Wallet.

Sincerely,
The Flint Wallet Team

Link to screenshots as a PoE: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VhV5SB7eqxShBbiReh_4i16iX5u31jS2?usp=sharing

ms.promise: Biometrics and Hardware Wallet on Flint Mobile iOS and Android
ms.criteria: You can use phone biometrics and Ledger with Bluetooth with Flint Wallet
ms.report:
In this PoM3 report, we are pleased to provide an update on the successful delivery of the two key functionalities for Flint. Although these functionalities were delivered in previous months, we have chosen to report on them now in order to maintain a logical and coherent order of reporting, as outlined in the PoM Reporting Plan. Our team is currently working diligently to achieve the next goal, which is to integrate EVM Smart-Contract support for Flint. This will be in addition to the already integrated Milkomede and send and receive functionalities.

PoM3 Deliverables:
Biometrics For Flint Mobile
Biometric unlocking for Flint mobile was released in late November. Since then you’ve been able to use your face or your fingerprint to effortlessly unlock Flint mobile on Android and iOS devices.

You can also use your biometrics to sign a transaction instead of having to enter your spending password! This makes the mobile Flint experience one of the most effortless and secure in the Cardano ecosystem, allowing you to quickly and easily interact with the Cardano blockchain.
https://medium.com/dcspark/what-a-year-a-look-back-at-flint-in-2022-dec8a687f64f

Hardware Wallet Support
Bluetooth Hardware Wallet Support: Both the mobile and desktop versions of Flint wallet now support Bluetooth connections for the Ledger Nano X hardware wallet. Increasing the speed and ease with which users can use their tokens secured in cold storage.
https://medium.com/dcspark/flint-wallet-on-mobile-now-supports-bluetooth-ledger-f07a04f6edce

Screenshots attached: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1vO4gPap_9oKQukhS9xinuFAi6d3iNV1q284MsmguoK4/edit#

ms.promise: Flint (Web, iOS and Android) allows to interact with EVM smart-contracts on Milkomeda
ms.criteria: Flint (Web, iOS and Android) allows users to interact with the top EVM smart-contracts on Milkomeda.
ms.report:
We are proud to announce that we completed dcSpark (the company itself) proposal with the Flint Release 2.7.0. 

Flint browser extension and mobile in-app browser allow seamless interaction with web applications. To interact with Flint, EVM DApps developers can now access the provider object that is injected into the browser by Flint. This provider object is globally available at window.evmproviders.flint and provides access to the latest Flint functionality. 

Flint EVM DApp integration guide (This documentation provides comprehensive information on the provider and its functionalities): 
https://github.com/dcSpark/milkomeda-documentation/blob/paulccari/add-flint-connector-guide/docs/cardano/for-developers/integrate-flint-wallet-dapps.mdx

Users can interact with EVM smart contracts from Flint (PoA)
